##### Project general facts

One 678 Residences is a contemporary high-rise development that redefines urban living through its elegant architecture and functional design. Rising 45 stories, the tower presents a sleek glass façade that reflects a modern architectural language focused on light, transparency, and vertical rhythm. Located within a well-connected urban setting, the project offers a refined residential experience tailored to both professionals and families seeking comfort and sophistication in the city.

The development features a thoughtfully curated selection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed with open layouts and generous proportions. Interiors are planned to maximize natural light and airflow, creating bright and comfortable living environments. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame panoramic city views, while well-balanced layouts ensure a seamless flow between living, dining, and private spaces, enhancing everyday functionality and livability.

Residences are finished with premium materials that emphasize warmth and understated luxury throughout. Natural textures, marble elements, and refined detailing create a modern yet inviting atmosphere. Apartments come with fully fitted kitchens designed for practicality and convenience, while units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their living spaces according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.
